title: KFC Kosova
description: kfckosova.com zoominfo.com/c/kfc-kosova/401225793 KFC Kosova is the official regional branch of the global fast-food chain, operating multiple restaurants across Kosovo, including a prominent location at the Albi Mall in Pristina. Their website serves as a central hub for customers to find nearby branches, check out menu options, and access delivery services. Additionally, the platform acts as a primary career portal for local job seekers to apply for various corporate and restaurant positions.
